analysis:
Examined all three CHANGELOG.md excerpts and the complete changed-range map. The changes add v0.10.1 candidate notes (head 11–134) and mark v0.10.0 published (136–138); the supplied historical BASE excerpts introduce no new behavior. Documentation alone does not establish a concrete implementation regression or deployed prerequisite, so no vulnerability finding is supported.
Security-relevant integration checks remain: head 17–19 and 65–68 describe external coordinator capability/refusal contracts needed to avoid model-wide availability failures; verify actual provider normalization, catalog gates and mixed-version routing rather than assume platform#411 is deployed. Head 27–37 and 63 describe expanded tool/JSON acceptance with withheld, schema-validated output; verify streaming cannot bypass validation (T-007, TB-007). Head 41 and 55–59 expand media acceptance; examine decoder bounds, cancellation and reservation release across the SDK/bridge (T-010, T-050). Head 45–46 replace repeated hashing with verified-load hashes and a persistent file-identity record; verify cache integrity, manifest binding and race handling against the adversarial operator (A-004, T-012, T-027). Head 70–74 broaden memory availability globally; inspect admission and KV accounting for double counting or overcommit.
Head 87–126 introduces desktop loopback control, dashboard credentials, Electron, update feeds and a bundled preview API. This expands the local operator/credential boundary (TB-003, A-008); review authentication, origin/renderer isolation, scoped-grant fallback, logout, executable verification and update provenance, and determine required threat-model additions. Implementations are not supplied here. Head 238–252 describes a resident prefix bank inconsistent with T-041's sole-SSD/no-RAM narrative, but lies outside the changed ranges: do not attribute its introduction to this PR. Integration should distinguish that existing documentation drift from any actual cache-policy changes.
